snippet.title: Mörker - Dark Retro FPS Gameplay Trailer. Everything Wants You Dead
snippet.description:
Mörker is an old-school dark fantasy action FPS inspired by 90s shooters.
Fight cultists, undead, and other horrors in brutal combat where everything wants you dead.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369430

Mörker (also spelled Morker)
#indiegame #retrofps #boomershooter
